title: Non-determinism of pkg_deb because of control.tar.gz

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

Building the same deb package twice results two packages with different hashes. Something similar happens here: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/1844. It seems that using gzip adds a timestamp which isn't zeroed. If we don't use gzip when building the control file then the package is deterministic. 

I can fix the issue with this patch:

``` diff
diff --git a/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_deb.py b/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_deb.py
index 99ae379..01f572f 100644
--- a/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_deb.py
+++ b/tools/build_defs/pkg/make_deb.py
@@ -120,7 +120,7 @@ def MakeDebianControlField(name, value, wrap=False):
 
 
 def CreateDebControl(extrafiles=None, **kwargs):
-  """Create the control.tar.gz file."""
+  """Create the control.tar file."""
   # create the control file
   controlfile = ''
   for values in DEBIAN_FIELDS:
@@ -130,7 +130,7 @@ def CreateDebControl(extrafiles=None, **kwargs):
       controlfile += MakeDebianControlField(fieldname, kwargs[key], values[2])
   # Create the control.tar file
   tar = StringIO()
-  with tarfile.open('control.tar.gz', mode='w:gz', fileobj=tar) as f:
+  with tarfile.open('control.tar', mode='w', fileobj=tar) as f:
     tarinfo = tarfile.TarInfo('control')
     tarinfo.size = len(controlfile)
     f.addfile(tarinfo, fileobj=StringIO(controlfile))
@@ -171,7 +171,7 @@ def CreateDeb(output,
   with open(output, 'w') as f:
     f.write('!<arch>\n')  # Magic AR header
     AddArFileEntry(f, 'debian-binary', '2.0\n')
-    AddArFileEntry(f, 'control.tar.gz', control)
+    AddArFileEntry(f, 'control.tar', control)
     # Tries to preserve the extension name
     ext = os.path.basename(data).split('.')[-2:]
     if len(ext) < 2:
```

Building the following pkg_deb shouild results in a .deb which has the same hash each time it's built.

### BUILD
``` 
pkg_tar(
    name = "data",
    package_dir = "/opt",
    files = [":test.txt"],
    mode = "0755"
)

pkg_deb(
   name="t",
   version="1",
   data=":data",
   package="test",
   maintainer="Ross",
   description="hello world"
)
```

### Environment info
* Operating System:
Ubuntu 16.10

* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`):
```
$ bazel info release
release 0.5.4
```
